set.body: Epic: bd-01KWVZPNECAPJ19KD7HDD8ERRA. Add thin Field, FieldDataRef, OperatorCache, OperatorCacheKey, and FieldRuntime contracts over compiled SpatialOperator values. Acceptance: graph remains immutable and cache-free, shared code includes an in-memory cache, field views are inspectable before materialization, no hidden file handles or ambient mutable registries, and dataset/image adapters can be added later without changing the core.
set.title: Field runtime and operator cache contracts
